MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Panda adapter fits my past choice of a USB Wi-Fi adapter with Linux support, although that familiarity alone does not give me a reason to replace mine.",
    "The Ethernet cables relate to my most recent USB-to-gigabit-Ethernet adapter purchase and could help connect it, provided the length and quantity fit my setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The drives, thermal paste and CPU cooler assume a storage or maintenance project that my accessory purchases do not establish.",
    "The 10/100Mbps switch would restrict the speed available through my gigabit adapter, so its networking connection is less useful than it first appears.",
    "A tablet mount does not establish a need for a dual-monitor stand, and my connectivity purchases give me no reason to want a voice-controlled speaker."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in almost any desktop upgrade.",
    "My earlier Wi-Fi adapter purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy another adapter or extend coverage, without evidence that either is needed."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase points toward practical wired connectivity, where matching speed and connection requirements matters.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and serve specific purposes; a related item needs to solve a concrete problem before I would act.",
    "Replacement adapters and cable packs depend on what I already have and the exact setup I need, including cable length and quantity."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical connectivity accessories but stretched it into upgrade and replacement needs I have not expressed."
}
